end.parentNote: Asha practised naming small animals found in soil and leaf litter, using a list and follow-up questions. Pihu identified several examples and checked whether millipedes, woodlice, and termites belong. The woodlouse/termite order was not settled before the lesson ended. At home, look at a few safe garden or leaf-litter pictures and name the animals together, without needing to memorise an order.
